title: Beyond CLIP: Calibrated (Few-Shot) Defect Detection With System One Decision Models
title_zh: 超越CLIP：基于系统一决策模型的校准（少样本）缺陷检测

paragraphs.en: 将结构化决策模型应用于少样本缺陷检测，每类仅需2张图像即超越CLIP，并提供校准与智能体改进方法。 Cameras and vision sensors are widely used for product and process inspection in manufacturing environments. Traditionally, this process required thousands of images of both nominal and defective products to train such models. Recent research shows that vision transformer (ViT) models, such as CLIP, can reduce this requirement to 50-100 images per nominal and defective class. However, collecting even 50 defective images can be difficult in high-yield or low-volume manufacturing processes. In this paper, we examine the utility of two recently proposed structured decision models (Jev and Clef-Flash) in applications using as few as k=2 reference images per class at inference. In the process, we provide three main contributions: (a) a framework for k-shot learning of these models for image classification/inspection applications; (b) an agentic approach for automatically refining the text descriptions that guide image classification in these decision models; and (c) an approach to calibrate the resulting defect probabilities to improve their reliability for inspection decisions. We test these contributions in five manufacturing case studies. Using two reference images per class, both Jev and Clef-Flash outperform CLIP's test accuracies with the same references (0.75-1.00 [Jev] and 0.71-0.99 [Clef-Flash] vs 0.67-0.84 [CLIP]). Furthermore, we show that our agentic refinement of text descriptions significantly improves accuracy across 6 of 8 model-application combinations, and our calibration approach reduces the Brier score in 13 of the 15 model-application configurations. To support the reproducibility of our work, we provide our replication code and have created the R "decisions" package for evaluating additional models. We also provide a publicly available web app that allows practitioners to inspect their own images with no code.
paragraphs.zh: 将结构化决策模型应用于少样本缺陷检测，每类仅需2张图像即超越CLIP，并提供校准与智能体改进方法。摄像头和视觉传感器在制造环境中被广泛用于产品和过程检测。 传统上，这一过程需要成千上万张合格产品和缺陷产品的图像来训练此类模型。 最近的研究表明，视觉Transformer（ViT）模型（如CLIP）可以将这一需求降低到每个合格类和缺陷类50-100张图像。 然而，在高良率或小批量的制造过程中，即使收集50张缺陷图像也可能很困难。 在本文中，我们检验了两种最近提出的结构化决策模型（Jev和Clef-Flash）在推理时每类仅使用少至k=2张参考图像的应用中的效用。 在此过程中，我们提供了三项主要贡献：(a) 一个用于这些模型在图像分类/检测应用中k样本学习的框架；(b) 一种自动优化文本描述的智能体方法，这些文本描述用于引导这些决策模型中的图像分类；(c) 一种校准所得缺陷概率的方法，以提高其在检测决策中的可靠性。 我们在五个制造案例研究中测试了这些贡献。 每类使用两张参考图像，Jev和Clef-Flash在相同参考图像下的测试准确率均超过CLIP（0.75-1.00 [Jev]和0.71-0.99 [Clef-Flash]对比0.67-0.84 [CLIP]）。 此外，我们表明，对文本描述的智能体优化在8个模型-应用组合中的6个显著提高了准确率，而我们的校准方法在15个模型-应用配置中的13个降低了Brier分数。 为支持我们工作的可复现性，我们提供了复现代码，并创建了用于评估其他模型的R语言"decisions"软件包。 我们还提供了一个公开可用的网页应用，使从业者无需编写代码即可检测自己的图像。
